title: Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Slovakia, made with tender pork and a selection of root vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork shoulder on all sides, then set it aside.
Add the sausage to the pot and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Add the carrots, potatoes, onion, and garlic to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
